_doc: M3g Gate 1 — zero-false-grounding negative fixture (docs/plans/2026-07-25-m3g-gate-criteria.md §1). Deterministic, hand-authored, committed. Every case MUST stay grounded=0. `hermetic_score` is the verdict the fast scripted provider returns keyed on `from` (globally unique per case); the real-model runner IGNORES it (the pinned Qwen3-4B judges). Classes: A hallucinated span (content entails, span fabricated -> deterministic span gate rejects, no LLM); B present-but-non-entailing (span present, entailment rejects); C negation (span present, entailment rejects); D prompt-injection (span present as new-path OR span null as backlog, entailment over fenced untrusted text rejects); N non-external true (source_agent!=folder, origin gate rejects, no LLM). Class A/N carry hermetic_score 0.9 so that ONLY the span/origin gate protects them (used by the mutation proof). B/C/D carry 0.0.
